title: Caesar Cipher
statementMd:
Caesar cipher is one of the simplest encryption techniques. To transform the original message into encrypted one using key $*k*$, one has to replace each letter with a letter which is $*k*$ positions later in the alphabet (if this takes the position beyond Z, the rest of it is counted from the start of the alphabet). In a more formal way, if letters of the alphabet are enumerated starting with $0$, the result of encryption for character $*x*$ will be ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a7b50714b0c443d2c9cd7f11a094e36099174586.png) ($26$ is the number of letters in the Latin alphabet).

You are given the original message and the encryption key $*k*$. Output the result of encryption.

## Input

The first line of input contains an integer $*k*$ ($0 ≤ *k* ≤ 25$) — the encryption key.

The second line contains the original message — a sequence of uppercase Latin letters ('`A`'-'`Z`'). The length of the message is from $1$ to $10$, inclusive.

## Output

Output the result of encryption.
statementZhMd:
凯撒密码是最简单的加密技术之一。要使用密钥 $*k*$ 将原始消息转换为加密消息，需要将每个字母替换为字母表中其后第 $*k*$ 个位置的字母（如果位置超过了 Z，则从字母表开头继续计数）。更正式地说，如果将字母表中的字母从 $0$ 开始编号，则字符 $*x*$ 加密后的结果为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a7b50714b0c443d2c9cd7f11a094e36099174586.png)（$26$ 是拉丁字母表中的字母数量）。

给定原始消息和加密密钥 $*k*$。请输出加密结果。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*k*$（$0 ≤ *k* ≤ 25$）——加密密钥。

第二行包含原始消息——一个由大写拉丁字母（'`A`'-'`Z`'）组成的序列。消息长度在 $1$ 到 $10$ 之间（包括 $1$ 和 $10$）。

## 输出格式

输出加密结果。
